request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, and critical process management for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 25,400,000 ADA for three work packages covering operations and ecosystem coordination, technical stewardship and incident response, and management of critical processes.
The proposal states Intersect’s current ask is reduced from last year’s $7.875M to $6.35M while preserving functions considered critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.

Intersect claims it has matured into a focused operational layer that supports committees and working groups, stewards core Haskell repositories, coordinates upgrades and incident response, and administers community-approved initiatives.
Intersect claims it has already coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission and links to the relevant governance action.
The proposal discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through three prior Cardano Treasury withdrawal governance actions in the past 24 months.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.

Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with stated TRSC and PSSC addresses, admin roles, leadership roles, and six external oversight entities for specified authorization thresholds.
The proposal says the community can audit and track the withdrawn ADA through a Sundae treasury dashboard and on-chain verification, and references the smart contract repository and audit reports.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect’s 2026-2027 governance coordination and technical stewardship operations, with work packages, prior-funding disclosure, NCL compliance claim, smart-contract custody details, oversight structure, and several external references for voting, audits, contracts, and dashboards.
